_about: LEGO minifigure joints. official_mm: LDraw geometry (1 LDU = 0.4 mm). model_mm: what to model so the printed part fits on the Adventurer 5M, 0.4 nozzle, PLA, figurine profile. Each model value was printed and tested.

neck_stud.evidence: 4.76 loose in a real head; 4.9 gripped in PETG but is a little loose in PLA (2026-09-27); 5.0 is the next try, untested

head_socket.evidence: fits both a real torso (4.8 stud) and the printed 4.9 stud; PLA v12 on raft holds on an official torso better than every earlier try (2026-09-27)

hip_top_studs.evidence: hollow 0.78 mm walls snapped; vertical solid studs snapped; solid studs printed lying hold and fit a real torso

official_mm.note: snap fit on the hip pin

leg_pin_hole.evidence: pin 2.35: hole 2.45 seized, 2.65 fell out, 2.50 clips and turns

foot_hole.evidence: 5.0 fit a baseplate stud only just; 5.1 fits

arm_peg.evidence: a 4.4 ball resting on the hole rim fell out; the 3.85 peg printed on the arm's edge holds, not perfect but accepted (2026-09-27)
